## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include failures, skipped checks, and device/browser limitations.

## Screenshots or recordings

For visible changes, show the affected screens and viewport/device details. Remove this section when it does not apply.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the existing architecture and conventions.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and the changelog are updated where needed.
- [ ] New or modified assets include the required sources, licenses, and credits, if applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private configuration, or unrelated generated files are included.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/tirthankardgen-cell/Bap-Ka-Rasta/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Report vulnerabilities through the [private security process](https://github.com/tirthankardgen-cell/Bap-Ka-Rasta/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
